name: Collateral Status
definition: Specifies the status of the collateral or of an event related to collateral.

ResponseStatus.name: Response Status
ResponseStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the response to a collateral claim, proposal or substitution proposal.

CollateralManagementCancellationReason.name: Collateral Management Cancellation Reason
CollateralManagementCancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the cancellation of a message.

SubstitutionStatus.name: Substitution Status
SubstitutionStatus.definition: Provides details about the status of the collateral substitution, either released or returned.

InterestRejectionReason.name: Interest Rejection Reason
InterestRejectionReason.definition: Provides the interest rejection reason using an ISO 20022 code.

MarginCallResponse.name: Margin Call Response
MarginCallResponse.definition: Specifies whether the margin call request was sent on a non valuation day or was received after notification time.

Settlement.name: Settlement
Settlement.definition: Provides the settlement status of the collateral.

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation Reason
CancellationReason.definition: Provides details about the status of the collateral cancellation.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Collateral for which a status is provided.
